27	/// parse or resolution work runs. Generous enough for the flagship fixtures
28	/// (two modules, ~2 KB), tight enough to deny conversational-workflow DoS.

32	/// Reject oversized source maps before parsing (APP015, authored source).
33	pub(crate) fn enforce_source_map_budget(
34	    sources_json: &str,
35	) -> Result<(), Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>> {
36	    let mut diags = Vec::new();
37	    if sources_json.len() > SOURCE_MAP_MAX_BYTES {
38	        diags.push(
39	            ApplicationDiagnostic::new(
40	                ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App015,
41	                format!(
42	                    "sources_json is {} bytes, exceeds the {}-byte public boundary budget",
43	                    sources_json.len(),
44	                    SOURCE_MAP_MAX_BYTES
45	                ),
46	            )
47	            .with_document_kind("authored_source"),
48	        );
49	    }
50	    // Cheap module-count estimate: count string-literal openings (each
51	    // key:value pair has at minimum two — key + value). The full structural
52	    // parse happens next; this only gates DoS before it.
53	    let mut quote_count = 0usize;
54	    let mut in_string = false;
55	    let mut escape = false;
56	    for ch in sources_json.chars() {
57	        if in_string {
58	            if escape {
59	                escape = false;
60	            } else if ch == '\\' {
61	                escape = true;
62	            } else if ch == '"' {
63	                in_string = false;
64	            }
65	        } else if ch == '"' {
66	            in_string = true;
67	            quote_count += 1;
68	        }
69	    }
70	    // Two string-literal openings per key:value pair is a safe lower bound:
71	    // extra string literals inside source text only reduce the pair count.
72	    let approx_pairs = quote_count.saturating_div(2);
73	    if approx_pairs > SOURCE_MAP_MAX_MODULES {
74	        diags.push(
75	            ApplicationDiagnostic::new(
76	                ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App015,
77	                format!(
78	                    "sources_json has approximately {} modules, exceeds the {}-module public boundary budget",

80	                ),
81	            )

83	        );

87	    } else {

104	/// `inputs.semantic_pack_set_hash` and the envelope's `semantic_packs`.

106	    entry_logical_path: &str,
107	    sources_json: &str,
108	    semantic_packs: &[(String, String)],
109	) -> Result<ApplicationContractDocument, Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>> {

197	    set: &ResolvedModuleSet,
198	) -> Result<crate::graph::Graph, Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>> {

200	    // authoring module's concept identity (D3). Namespace-less modules use

202	    let mut groups: indexmap::IndexMap<String, crate::parser::ast::Ast> = indexmap::IndexMap::new();

215	        });

217	            .declarations
218	            .extend(module.ast.declarations.iter().cloned());
219	    }
220	    let mut graph = crate::graph::Graph::new();
221	    for (_, ast) in groups {

224	            &crate::parser::ParseOptions::default(),

269	struct ModuleBindings {
270	    namespace: String,
271	    /// Locally visible name -> (target namespace, original name).

277	pub(crate) struct Ctx<'a> {
278	    set: &'a ResolvedModuleSet,
279	    bindings: Vec<ModuleBindings>,
280	}

283	    "record", "enum", "entity", "unit", "pattern", "role", "policy",

286	impl<'a> Ctx<'a> {
287	    pub(crate) fn new(set: &'a ResolvedModuleSet) -> Self {
288	        let namespace_of: HashMap<&str, String> = set
289	            .modules
290	            .iter()
291	            .map(|m| {
292	                (
293	                    m.logical_id.as_str(),
294	                    m.ast
295	                        .metadata
296	                        .namespace
297	                        .clone()
298	                        .unwrap_or_else(|| m.logical_id.clone()),
299	                )
300	            })
301	            .collect();
302	        // The resolver pushed exactly one import edge per import statement,
303	        // in statement order; a resolved set therefore maps each authored
304	        // import to its edge positionally — no specifier re-matching (D3).
305	        let mut edges_by_importer: HashMap<&str, Vec<&str>> = HashMap::new();
306	        for edge in &set.import_graph {
307	            edges_by_importer
308	                .entry(edge.importer.as_str())
309	                .or_default()
310	                .push(edge.imported.as_str());
311	        }
312	        let bindings = set
313	            .modules
314	            .iter()
315	            .map(|module| {
316	                let mut named = HashMap::new();
317	                let mut wildcard = HashMap::new();
318	                let edges = edges_by_importer.get(module.logical_id.as_str());
319	                for (index, import) in module.ast.metadata.imports.iter().enumerate() {
320	                    let Some(target_id) = edges.and_then(|e| e.get(index).copied()) else {
321	                        continue;
322	                    };
323	                    let Some(target_ns) = namespace_of.get(target_id) else {
324	                        continue;
325	                    };
326	                    match &import.specifier {
327	                        past::ImportSpecifier::Named(items) => {
328	                            for item in items {
329	                                let local = item.alias.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| item.name.clone());
330	                                named.insert(local, (target_ns.clone(), item.name.clone()));
331	                            }
332	                        }
333	                        past::ImportSpecifier::Wildcard(alias) => {
334	                            wildcard.insert(alias.clone(), target_ns.clone());
335	                        }
336	                    }
337	                }
338	                ModuleBindings {
339	                    namespace: namespace_of[module.logical_id.as_str()].clone(),
340	                    named,
341	                    wildcard,
342	                }
343	            })
344	            .collect();
345	        Self { set, bindings }
346	    }

352	    fn find_symbol_in(
353	        &self,
354	        namespace: &str,
355	        name: &str,
356	        slugs: &'static [&'static str],
357	    ) -> Option<(&ResolvedSymbol, &'static str)> {
358	        slugs.iter().find_map(|slug| {
359	            self.set
360	                .symbols
361	                .get(&format!("{namespace}.{slug}.{name}"))
362	                .map(|s| (s, *slug))

366	    /// Resolve a raw possibly alias-qualified reference against specific
367	    /// declaration slugs, returning the exact target identity (§8 envelope
368	    /// references). `None` when the reference does not resolve.
369	    pub(crate) fn resolve_concept(
370	        &self,
371	        module_index: usize,
372	        raw: &str,
373	        slugs: &'static [&'static str],
374	    ) -> Option<ConceptId> {
375	        let (alias, name) = split_symbol_ref(raw);
376	        let bindings = &self.bindings[module_index];
377	        let found = match alias {
378	            Some(alias) => {
379	                let ns = bindings.wildcard.get(alias)?;
380	                self.find_symbol_in(ns, name, slugs)
381	                    .filter(|(symbol, _)| symbol.exported)
382	            }
383	            None => {
384	                if let Some((ns, original)) = bindings.named.get(name) {
385	                    self.find_symbol_in(ns, original, slugs)
386	                } else {
387	                    self.find_symbol_in(&bindings.namespace, name, slugs)
388	                }
389	            }
390	        };
391	        found.map(|(symbol, _)| self.symbol_concept(symbol))
392	    }

394	    /// Resolve a possibly alias-qualified reference from `module_index`.
395	    fn resolve_ref(
396	        &self,
397	        module_index: usize,
398	        alias: Option<&str>,
399	        name: &str,
400	    ) -> Option<(&ResolvedSymbol, &'static str)> {
401	        let bindings = &self.bindings[module_index];
402	        match alias {
403	            Some(alias) => {
404	                let ns = bindings.wildcard.get(alias)?;
405	                let (symbol, slug) = self.find_symbol(ns, name)?;
406	                symbol.exported.then_some((symbol, slug))
407	            }
408	            None => {
409	                if let Some((ns, original)) = bindings.named.get(name) {
410	                    self.find_symbol(ns, original)
411	                } else {
412	                    self.find_symbol(&bindings.namespace, name)
413	                }
414	            }
415	        }

428	    /// Exact resolved identity of a symbol: its authoring module's namespace

430	    fn symbol_concept(&self, symbol: &ResolvedSymbol) -> ConceptId {
431	        let name = declared_name(self.decl_node(symbol)).unwrap_or_default();

435	    fn decl_node(&self, symbol: &ResolvedSymbol) -> &past::AstNode {
436	        let node =
437	            &self.set.modules[symbol.module_index].ast.declarations[symbol.declaration_index].node;
438	        match node {
439	            past::AstNode::Export(inner) => &inner.node,

448	        past::AstNode::Entity { name, .. }
449	        | past::AstNode::Role { name, .. }
450	        | past::AstNode::Pattern { name, .. }
451	        | past::AstNode::Policy { name, .. }
452	        | past::AstNode::Dimension { name } => Some(name),
453	        past::AstNode::UnitDeclaration { symbol, .. } => Some(symbol),
454	        past::AstNode::Record(decl) => Some(&decl.name),
455	        past::AstNode::Enum(decl) => Some(&decl.name),
456	        past::AstNode::Operation(decl) => Some(&decl.name),
457	        _ => None,
458	    }
459	}

461	/// Split a raw `symbol_ref` text (`Name` or `alias.Name`) into parts.
462	fn split_symbol_ref(raw: &str) -> (Option<&str>, &str) {
463	    match raw.split_once('.') {
464	        Some((alias, name)) if !alias.is_empty() && !name.is_empty() => (Some(alias), name),
465	        _ => (None, raw),

469	pub(crate) fn build_contract(
470	    set: &ResolvedModuleSet,
471	) -> Result<ApplicationContract, Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>> {
472	    let ctx = Ctx::new(set);
473	    let mut contract = ApplicationContract::default();
474	    let mut diags: Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic> = Vec::new();
475	
476	    for symbol in set.symbols.values() {
477	        let site = DeclSite {
478	            logical_module_id: &symbol.origin.logical_module_id,
479	            line: symbol.origin.line,
480	            column: symbol.origin.column,
481	        };
482	        match ctx.decl_node(symbol) {
483	            past::AstNode::Enum(decl) => {
484	                check_enum(decl, site, &mut diags);
485	                contract.enums.push(EnumContract {
486	                    id: ApplicationSymbolId(symbol.qualified_id.clone()),
487	                    name: nfc(&decl.name),
488	                    members: decl
489	                        .members
490	                        .iter()
491	                        .map(|m| EnumMember {
492	                            name: nfc(&m.name),
493	                            wire: nfc(&m.wire),
494	                        })
495	                        .collect(),
496	                });
497	            }
498	            past::AstNode::Record(decl) => {
499	                check_duplicate_fields(&decl.name, &decl.fields, site, &mut diags);
500	                check_record_defaults(&decl.name, &decl.fields, site, &mut diags);
501	                let fields = resolve_fields(&ctx, symbol, &decl.fields, false, site, &mut diags);
502	                contract.records.push(RecordContract {
503	                    id: ApplicationSymbolId(symbol.qualified_id.clone()),
504	                    name: nfc(&decl.name),
505	                    fields,
506	                });
507	            }
508	            past::AstNode::Entity {
509	                name,
510	                body: Some(body),
511	                ..
512	            } => {
513	                check_duplicate_fields(name, &body.fields, site, &mut diags);
514	                let key_field = check_entity_key(name, &body.fields, site, &mut diags);
515	                let fields = resolve_fields(&ctx, symbol, &body.fields, true, site, &mut diags);
516	                if let Some(key_field) = key_field {
517	                    contract.entities.push(EntityContract {
518	                        concept_id: ctx.symbol_concept(symbol),
519	                        name: name.clone(),
520	                        key_field: nfc(&key_field),
521	                        fields,
522	                    });
523	                }
524	            }
525	            // Operations lower in a second pass, after every record/entity
526	            // contract they reference has been constructed.
527	            past::AstNode::Operation(_) => {}
528	            _ => {}
529	        }
530	    }
531	
532	    let mut closure_codes: std::collections::HashSet<String> = std::collections::HashSet::new();
533	    let mut operations = Vec::new();
534	    for symbol in set.symbols.values() {
535	        let site = DeclSite {
536	            logical_module_id: &symbol.origin.logical_module_id,
537	            line: symbol.origin.line,
538	            column: symbol.origin.column,
539	        };
540	        if let past::AstNode::Operation(decl) = ctx.decl_node(symbol) {
541	            if let Some(op) = lower_operation(
542	                &ctx,
543	                &contract,
544	                symbol,
545	                decl,
546	                site,
547	                &mut closure_codes,
548	                &mut diags,
549	            ) {
550	                operations.push(op);
551	            }
552	        }
553	    }
554	    contract.operations = operations;
555	
556	    // §6 closure order: contract collections are sets, sorted by canonical
557	    // identity; only field/member/failure/binding lists keep authored order.
558	    contract.enums.sort_by(|a, b| a.id.0.cmp(&b.id.0));
559	    contract.records.sort_by(|a, b| a.id.0.cmp(&b.id.0));
560	    contract.entities.sort_by_key(|e| e.concept_id.to_string());
561	    contract.operations.sort_by(|a, b| a.id.0.cmp(&b.id.0));
562	
563	    if diags.is_empty() {
564	        Ok(contract)
565	    } else {
566	        sort_diagnostics(&mut diags);
567	        Err(diags)
568	    }
569	}

572	
573	fn field<'a>(fields: &'a [FieldContract], name: &str) -> Option<&'a FieldContract> {
574	    fields.iter().find(|f| f.name == name)

577	/// Same field type and canonical constraint set (order-free).
578	fn type_and_constraints_match(a: &FieldContract, b: &FieldContract) -> bool {
579	    a.field_type == b.field_type
580	        && a.constraints.len() == b.constraints.len()
581	        && a.constraints.iter().all(|c| b.constraints.contains(c))
582	}
583	
584	/// Same field type, optionality, and canonical constraint set.
585	fn fields_compatible(a: &FieldContract, b: &FieldContract) -> bool {
586	    type_and_constraints_match(a, b) && a.optional == b.optional
587	}
588	
589	fn is_scalar(f: &FieldContract) -> bool {
590	    matches!(f.field_type, FieldType::Scalar { .. })
591	}

593	#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
594	fn lower_operation(
595	    ctx: &Ctx,
596	    contract: &ApplicationContract,
597	    symbol: &ResolvedSymbol,
598	    decl: &past::OperationDecl,
599	    site: DeclSite,
600	    closure_codes: &mut std::collections::HashSet<String>,
601	    diags: &mut Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>,
602	) -> Option<OperationContract> {
603	    use past::OperationClause as C;
604	
605	    let defects = validate_clause_shape(&decl.clauses);
606	    if !defects.is_empty() {
607	        diags.push(site.diag(
608	            ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App001,
609	            format!(
610	                "operation '{}' is not generation-ready: {}",
611	                decl.name,
612	                defects.join("; ")
613	            ),
614	        ));
615	        return None;
616	    }
617	    let before = diags.len();
618	
619	    // Clause shape guarantees each of these appears exactly once.
620	    let mut intent = String::new();
621	    let mut actor_raw = "";
622	    let mut access_clause: Option<&C> = None;
623	    let mut input_raw = "";
624	    let mut output_raw = "";
625	    let mut state_raw = "";
626	    let mut effect_kind_raw = "";
627	    let mut effect_target_raw = "";
628	    let mut transaction_raw = "";
629	    let mut ast_failures: Vec<(String, Vec<FailureKind>, String)> = Vec::new();
630	    let mut idem_clause: Option<&C> = None;
631	    let mut conc_clause: Option<&C> = None;
632	    for clause in &decl.clauses {
633	        match clause {
634	            C::Intent(text) => intent = text.clone(),
635	            C::Actor { actor } => actor_raw = actor,
636	            C::AccessPublic | C::AccessPolicyGoverned { .. } => access_clause = Some(clause),
637	            C::Input { reference } => input_raw = reference,
638	            C::Output { reference } => output_raw = reference,
639	            C::State { reference } => state_raw = reference,
640	            C::Effect { kind, reference } => {
641	                effect_kind_raw = kind;
642	                effect_target_raw = reference;
643	            }
644	            C::Transaction { kind } => transaction_raw = kind,
645	            C::Failure {
646	                code,
647	                kinds,
648	                message,
649	            } => {
650	                let mut mapped = Vec::new();
651	                for raw in kinds {
652	                    match failure_kind(raw) {
653	                        Some(kind) => mapped.push(kind),
654	                        None => diags.push(site.diag(
655	                            ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App008,
656	                            format!(
657	                                "failure '{code}' of operation '{}' names unknown kind '{raw}'",
658	                                decl.name
659	                            ),
660	                        )),
661	                    }
662	                }
663	                ast_failures.push((code.clone(), mapped, message.clone()));
664	            }
665	            C::IdempotencyKeyed { .. }
666	            | C::IdempotencyInherent
667	            | C::IdempotencyNotApplicable { .. } => idem_clause = Some(clause),
668	            C::ConcurrencyUnique { .. }
669	            | C::ConcurrencyOptimistic { .. }
670	            | C::ConcurrencyReadSnapshot => conc_clause = Some(clause),
671	            C::Direction { .. }
672	            | C::EvidenceOperationTrace
673	            | C::LifecycleSynchronousRequestResponse => {}
674	        }
675	    }
676	
677	    let effect = match effect_kind_raw {
678	        "creates" => EffectKind::Creates,
679	        "mutates" => EffectKind::Mutates,
680	        "reads" => EffectKind::Reads,
681	        other => {
682	            diags.push(site.diag(
683	                ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App001,
684	                format!(
685	                    "effect '{other}' of operation '{}' is unsupported",
686	                    decl.name
687	                ),
688	            ));
689	            return None;
690	        }
691	    };
692	    let transaction = match transaction_raw {
693	        "single_aggregate" => TransactionBoundary::SingleAggregate,
694	        _ => TransactionBoundary::ReadOnly, // pairing already validated
695	    };
696	
697	    // Actor.
698	    let actor = if actor_raw == "anonymous" {
699	        ActorRef::Anonymous
700	    } else {
701	        let (alias, name) = split_symbol_ref(actor_raw);
702	        match ctx.resolve_ref(symbol.module_index, alias, name) {
703	            Some((role_symbol, "role")) => ActorRef::Role {
704	                role: ctx.symbol_concept(role_symbol),
705	            },
706	            _ => {
707	                diags.push(site.diag(
708	                    ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App002,
709	                    format!(
710	                        "actor '{actor_raw}' of operation '{}' does not resolve to a role",
711	                        decl.name
712	                    ),
713	                ));
714	                ActorRef::Anonymous
715	            }
716	        }
717	    };
718	
719	    // Input / output / state / effect target resolution.
720	    let resolve_record = |label: &str, raw: &str, diags: &mut Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>| {
721	        let (alias, name) = split_symbol_ref(raw);
722	        match ctx.resolve_ref(symbol.module_index, alias, name) {
723	            Some((s, "record")) => contract
724	                .records
725	                .iter()
726	                .find(|r| r.id.0 == s.qualified_id)
727	                .map(|r| (s.qualified_id.clone(), r)),
728	            Some((_, slug)) => {
729	                diags.push(site.diag(
730	                    ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App006,
731	                    format!(
732	                        "{label} '{raw}' of operation '{}' resolves to {slug}; a record is required",
733	                        decl.name
734	                    ),
735	                ));
736	                None
737	            }
738	            None => {
739	                diags.push(site.diag(
740	                    ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App002,
741	                    format!(
742	                        "{label} '{raw}' of operation '{}' does not resolve in the symbol table",
743	                        decl.name
744	                    ),
745	                ));
746	                None
747	            }
748	        }
749	    };
750	    let input = resolve_record("input", input_raw, diags);
751	    let output = resolve_record("output", output_raw, diags);
752	
753	    let state = {
754	        let (alias, name) = split_symbol_ref(state_raw);
755	        match ctx.resolve_ref(symbol.module_index, alias, name) {
756	            Some((s, "entity")) => {
757	                if matches!(ctx.decl_node(s), past::AstNode::Entity { body: None, .. }) {
758	                    diags.push(site.diag(
759	                        ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App011,
760	                        format!(
761	                            "state '{state_raw}' of operation '{}' lacks a typed body",
762	                            decl.name
763	                        ),
764	                    ));
765	                    None
766	                } else {
767	                    let concept_id = ctx.symbol_concept(s);
768	                    contract
769	                        .entities
770	                        .iter()
771	                        .find(|e| e.concept_id == concept_id)
772	                        .map(|e| (s.qualified_id.clone(), e))
773	                }
774	            }
775	            _ => {
776	                diags.push(site.diag(
777	                    ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App002,
778	                    format!(
779	                        "state '{state_raw}' of operation '{}' does not resolve to an entity",
780	                        decl.name
781	                    ),
782	                ));
783	                None
784	            }
785	        }
786	    };
787	    {
788	        let (alias, name) = split_symbol_ref(effect_target_raw);
789	        let target = ctx.resolve_ref(symbol.module_index, alias, name);
790	        match (&state, target) {
791	            (Some((state_qid, _)), Some((t, "entity"))) if t.qualified_id != *state_qid => {
792	                diags.push(site.diag(
793	                    ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App011,
794	                    format!(
795	                        "effect target '{effect_target_raw}' of operation '{}' differs from state '{state_raw}'",
796	                        decl.name
797	                    ),
798	                ));
799	            }
800	            (Some(_), Some((_, "entity"))) => {}
801	            (Some(_), _) => diags.push(site.diag(
802	                ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App002,
803	                format!(
804	                    "effect target '{effect_target_raw}' of operation '{}' does not resolve to an entity",
805	                    decl.name
806	                ),
807	            )),
808	            (None, _) => {}
809	        }
810	    }
811	
812	    // Failures.
813	    let input_has_constraints = input
814	        .as_ref()
815	        .is_some_and(|(_, r)| r.fields.iter().any(|f| !f.constraints.is_empty()));
816	    let mut required_kinds = Vec::new();
817	    if input_has_constraints {
818	        required_kinds.push(FailureKind::InputValidation);
819	    }
820	    if matches!(effect, EffectKind::Reads | EffectKind::Mutates) {
821	        required_kinds.push(FailureKind::MissingState);
822	    }
823	    if matches!(idem_clause, Some(C::IdempotencyKeyed { .. })) {
824	        required_kinds.push(FailureKind::IdempotencyConflict);
825	    }
826	    if matches!(
827	        conc_clause,
828	        Some(C::ConcurrencyUnique { .. } | C::ConcurrencyOptimistic { .. })
829	    ) {
830	        required_kinds.push(FailureKind::ConcurrencyConflict);
831	    }
832	    validate_failures(
833	        &decl.name,
834	        &ast_failures,
835	        &required_kinds,
836	        closure_codes,
837	        site,
838	        diags,
839	    );
840	    let declared_codes: Vec<&str> = ast_failures.iter().map(|(c, _, _)| c.as_str()).collect();
841	
842	    // Strategies (APP009/APP010).
843	    let strategy_field = |field_name: &str,
844	                          want_int: bool,
845	                          need_state: bool,
846	                          diags: &mut Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>| {
847	        let Some((_, input_rec)) = &input else { return };
848	        match field(&input_rec.fields, field_name) {
849	            Some(f) if !f.optional && is_scalar(f) => {
850	                if want_int
851	                    && !matches!(
852	                        f.field_type,
853	                        FieldType::Scalar {
854	                            scalar: ScalarType::Int
855	                        }
856	                    )
857	                {
858	                    diags.push(site.diag(
859	                        ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App009,
860	                        format!(
861	                            "strategy field '{field_name}' of operation '{}' must be a required int",
862	                            decl.name
863	                        ),
864	                    ));
865	                }
866	                if need_state {
867	                    let compatible = state.as_ref().is_some_and(|(_, e)| {
868	                        field(&e.fields, field_name).is_some_and(|sf| {
869	                            sf.field_type == f.field_type && !sf.optional
870	                        })
871	                    });
872	                    if state.is_some() && !compatible {
873	                        diags.push(site.diag(
874	                            ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App009,
875	                            format!(
876	                                "strategy field '{field_name}' of operation '{}' has no compatible required state field",
877	                                decl.name
878	                            ),
879	                        ));
880	                    }
881	                }
882	            }
883	            _ => diags.push(site.diag(
884	                ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App009,
885	                format!(
886	                    "strategy field '{field_name}' of operation '{}' must be a required scalar input field",
887	                    decl.name
888	                ),
889	            )),
890	        }
891	    };
892	    let pairing = |what: &str, diags: &mut Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>| {
893	        diags.push(site.diag(
894	            ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App009,
895	            format!(
896	                "{what} of operation '{}' falls outside the §4 strategy/effect pairing",
897	                decl.name
898	            ),
899	        ));
900	    };
901	    let idempotency = match (effect, idem_clause) {
902	        (EffectKind::Creates | EffectKind::Mutates, Some(C::IdempotencyKeyed { field: f })) => {
903	            strategy_field(f, false, false, diags);
904	            IdempotencyStrategy::KeyedBy { field: f.clone() }
905	        }
906	        (EffectKind::Reads, Some(C::IdempotencyInherent)) => IdempotencyStrategy::Inherent,
907	        (
908	            EffectKind::Reads,
909	            Some(C::IdempotencyNotApplicable {
910	                reason,
911	                explanation,
912	            }),
913	        ) => {
914	            if reason != "read_only" {
915	                diags.push(site.diag(
916	                    ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App010,
917	                    format!(
918	                        "not_applicable reason '{reason}' on operation '{}' is not proven by its effect",
919	                        decl.name
920	                    ),
921	                ));
922	            }
923	            IdempotencyStrategy::NotApplicable(NotApplicable {
924	                explanation: explanation.clone(),
925	            })
926	        }
927	        (_, Some(C::IdempotencyNotApplicable { .. })) => {
928	            diags.push(site.diag(
929	                ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App010,
930	                format!(
931	                    "not_applicable idempotency on write operation '{}' has no reachable proof",
932	                    decl.name
933	                ),
934	            ));
935	            IdempotencyStrategy::Inherent
936	        }
937	        _ => {
938	            pairing("idempotency strategy", diags);
939	            IdempotencyStrategy::Inherent
940	        }
941	    };
942	    let concurrency = match (effect, conc_clause) {
943	        (EffectKind::Creates, Some(C::ConcurrencyUnique { field: f })) => {
944	            strategy_field(f, false, true, diags);
945	            ConcurrencyStrategy::UniqueKey { field: f.clone() }
946	        }
947	        (EffectKind::Mutates, Some(C::ConcurrencyOptimistic { field: f })) => {
948	            strategy_field(f, true, true, diags);
949	            ConcurrencyStrategy::OptimisticVersion { field: f.clone() }
950	        }
951	        (EffectKind::Reads, Some(C::ConcurrencyReadSnapshot)) => ConcurrencyStrategy::ReadSnapshot,
952	        _ => {
953	            pairing("concurrency strategy", diags);
954	            ConcurrencyStrategy::ReadSnapshot
955	        }
956	    };
957	
958	    // State lowering and output projection (APP011).
959	    if let (Some((_, input_rec)), Some((_, entity))) = (&input, &state) {
960	        let app011 = |msg: String, diags: &mut Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>| {
961	            diags.push(site.diag(ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App011, msg));
962	        };
963	        let key_lookup = |diags: &mut Vec<ApplicationDiagnostic>| match field(
964	            &input_rec.fields,
965	            &entity.key_field,
966	        ) {
967	            Some(f) if !f.optional => {}
968	            _ => app011(
969	                format!(
970	                    "operation '{}' has no required input field matching entity key '{}'",
971	                    decl.name, entity.key_field
972	                ),
973	                diags,
974	            ),
975	        };
976	        match effect {
977	            EffectKind::Creates => {
978	                for sf in &entity.fields {
979	                    match field(&input_rec.fields, &sf.name) {
980	                        Some(inf) => {
981	                            if !type_and_constraints_match(inf, sf) {
982	                                app011(
983	                                    format!(
984	                                        "input field '{}' of operation '{}' is not compatible with its state field",
985	                                        sf.name, decl.name
986	                                    ),
987	                                    diags,
988	                                );
989	                            } else if inf.optional && !sf.optional && sf.default.is_none() {
990	                                app011(
991	                                    format!(
992	                                        "optional input field '{}' sources required state field of operation '{}' with no default",
993	                                        sf.name, decl.name
994	                                    ),
995	                                    diags,
996	                                );
997	                            }
998	                        }
999	                        None if sf.default.is_none() && !sf.optional => app011(
1000	                            format!(
1001	                                "create of operation '{}' cannot construct required state field '{}'",
1002	                                decl.name, sf.name
1003	                            ),
1004	                            diags,
1005	                        ),
1006	                        None => {}
1007	                    }
1008	                }
1009	            }
1010	            EffectKind::Mutates => {
1011	                key_lookup(diags);
1012	                let strategy_fields: Vec<&str> = [
1013	                    match &idempotency {
1014	                        IdempotencyStrategy::KeyedBy { field } => Some(field.as_str()),
1015	                        _ => None,
1016	                    },
1017	                    match &concurrency {
1018	                        ConcurrencyStrategy::OptimisticVersion { field } => Some(field.as_str()),
1019	                        _ => None,
1020	                    },
1021	                ]
1022	                .into_iter()
1023	                .flatten()
1024	                .collect();
1025	                for inf in &input_rec.fields {
1026	                    if inf.name == entity.key_field || strategy_fields.contains(&inf.name.as_str())
1027	                    {
1028	                        continue;
1029	                    }
1030	                    match field(&entity.fields, &inf.name) {
1031	                        Some(sf) if fields_compatible(inf, sf) => {}
1032	                        Some(_) => app011(
1033	                            format!(
1034	                                "input field '{}' of operation '{}' is not compatible with its state field",
1035	                                inf.name, decl.name
1036	                            ),
1037	                            diags,
1038	                        ),
1039	                        None => app011(
1040	                            format!(
1041	                                "mutate of operation '{}' contains unmapped input field '{}'",
1042	                                decl.name, inf.name
1043	                            ),
1044	                            diags,
1045	                        ),
1046	                    }
1047	                }
1048	            }
1049	            EffectKind::Reads => key_lookup(diags),
1050	        }
1051	        if let Some((_, output_rec)) = &output {
1052	            for of in &output_rec.fields {
1053	                match field(&entity.fields, &of.name) {
1054	                    Some(sf) if fields_compatible(of, sf) => {}
1055	                    _ => app011(
1056	                        format!(
1057	                            "output field '{}' of operation '{}' cannot project a same-named compatible state field",
1058	                            of.name, decl.name
1059	                        ),
1060	                        diags,
1061	                    ),
1062	                }
1063	            }
1064	        }
1065	    }
1066	
1067	    // Access.
1068	    let access = match access_clause {
1069	        Some(C::AccessPolicyGoverned { bindings }) => {
1070	            let mut lowered = Vec::new();
1071	            for binding in bindings {
1072	                if binding.enforcement_point != "precondition" {
1073	                    diags.push(site.diag(
1074	                        ApplicationDiagnosticCode::App007,

## Summary

The subagent's version claim was stale, not the actual bug: `crates/sea-forge-domainforge/Cargo.toml` was already bumped to `domainforge-core =0.15.0` (uncommitted), but the adapter code (`lib.rs`) still used the ~140-line hand-rolled import resolver written against 0.13.0's constraints, which don't apply anymore.

**What 0.15.0 actually added** (commit `3802392`, confirmed against both the crates.io cache and your local `~/projects/domainforge` checkout): a public, in-memory, namespace-aware API — `domainforge_core::application::resolve_application_graph(entry_uri, sources_json)` — that takes exactly the shape `SeaSourceSet` already has (a map of uri → content), resolves imports, detects cycles, checks exports, and builds the graph, no filesystem/CLI involved. This is precisely what plan step 3 asked for ("use the pinned DomainForge namespace-aware library API"), so the redesign-trigger deviation was never actually necessary once the version bump landed.

**Real bug found and fixed:** the hand-rolled reimplementation only *validated* that imports resolved but built the graph from the entry file's own AST only (`parse_to_graph_with_options(&entry.content, ...)`), silently dropping imported entities from the resulting model. `resolve_application_graph` correctly merges every reachable module into the graph. Added an assertion to `multi_file_model_with_resolved_import_passes` proving the imported `Customer` entity is now present in `concept_refs` — this would have failed under the old code.

Changes: `crates/sea-forge-domainforge/src/lib.rs` (deleted `resolve_imports`/`detect_cycle`/`collect_exports`/`declaration_name`, replaced with one call + a diagnostic formatter) and one test assertion. All 21 tests pass, clippy clean, both spec gates green.
